title: Persistence
key_points: IPFS treats persistence and permanence differently.
Pinning helps keep data from being discarded in IPFS.
Garbage collection can remove data that is not pinned or referenced.
There are various pinning services available to help maintain the availability of data on IPFS.
limitations: This document provides general information and may not cover all specific use cases.
The effectiveness of persistence depends on the usage patterns and retention policies of nodes in the IPFS network.
asserts: Pinning is a key mechanism to maintain data availability and prevent garbage collection from removing content in IPFS.
scope: This document explains how pinning helps keep data persistent in the IPFS network, contrasting persistence with permanence, and discussing the role of garbage collection and pinning services.
